subject.title: fix: use atomic writes for crash-safety on exec approvals, restart sentinel, shell profile, and saveJsonFile

question: Should OpenClaw land a narrow atomic-write fix for shell completion profile creation/update, and what profile permission or symlink behavior must it preserve?
rationale: The remaining code change mutates user shell startup files, and the issue is already labeled for maintainer review/no-new-fix-pr after prior related completion work avoided this exact subpath.

options.title: Approve narrow profile atomic write
options.body: Use the existing atomic text helper for the two profile writes, preserve current path resolution and standard profile permissions, and add focused completion-runtime regression coverage.

options.title: Defer until profile policy is defined
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers decide how symlinked profiles, missing profile creation, and mode preservation should behave.

options.title: Accept current direct writes
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide completion profile rewrites are low enough risk to leave non-atomic despite the crash-safety concern.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow profile atomic write
recommendation.body: Use the existing atomic text helper for the two profile writes, preserve current path resolution and standard profile permissions, and add focused completion-runtime regression coverage.
